# AK Claims

> Educational guide to Alaska insurance claims: homeowners, auto, earthquake, ice dam and frozen pipe claims, documenting damage, and disputes with the Alaska Division of Insurance.

Educational only; not legal, financial or insurance advice. AK Claims is not an insurer, adjuster or law firm.

## Pages

- [Alaska Insurance Claims Guide: Home, Auto, Earthquake and Winter Damage](https://akclaims.com/): Overview of the claim guides and common questions.
- [Homeowners Insurance Claims in Alaska: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://akclaims.com/homeowners-insurance-claims-alaska.html): How a homeowners claim works, from first notice to final payment, and what your policy usually covers.
- [Auto Insurance Claims in Alaska: Crashes, Moose and Windshields](https://akclaims.com/auto-insurance-claims-alaska.html): Crashes, moose collisions, cracked windshields and what Alaska's at-fault system means for you.
- [Earthquake Insurance Claims in Alaska: Coverage, Deductibles and Damage](https://akclaims.com/earthquake-insurance-claims-alaska.html): Why standard policies exclude earthquakes, how quake deductibles work, and documenting seismic damage.
- [Ice Dam and Frozen Pipe Insurance Claims: Winter Water Damage](https://akclaims.com/ice-dam-frozen-pipe-claims.html): When winter water damage is usually covered, when it isn't, and what to do in the first hours.
- [How to Document Property Damage for an Insurance Claim](https://akclaims.com/document-property-damage.html): Photos, inventories, receipts and a claim diary: building a record that supports your claim.
- [Insurance Claim Disputes and the Alaska Division of Insurance](https://akclaims.com/insurance-claim-disputes-alaska.html): Options when you disagree with a decision: appeal, appraisal, complaints, adjusters and attorneys.
- [About AK Claims](https://akclaims.com/about.html): Who we are, what we aren't, and our disclaimer.
- [Contact AK Claims](https://akclaims.com/contact.html): How to reach us by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://akclaims.com/privacy.html): How this site handles your information.
